paragraphs.text: The barren, uninhabitable Northern Ice Wastes lay in the northernmost part of Corondor .
The fact that they are partly frozen can only be explained by a cold Gulfstream because Corondor doesn't lie near the pole-circle of Dominaria .

To travel beyond its horizons is to touch the top of the world. “Living in the Wastes” is an old Arathoxian expression for insanity, for to live in this land is proof of either great madness or great power. Often both.
